text_block_list.text:
In the lobby of a luxury spa facility a 
short distance from the academy. Changed 
into sauna wear, I wait for Satono Crown.
As for why I'm here—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"—'Looking to shake off your daily 
fatigue'? Then I'd definitely recommend 
the sauna!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I love going to! It's a 
mixed-gender sauna where you wear 
swimwear, and the relaxation facilities 
are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"How about it when you have some time? If 
you'd like, I can give you a few tips on 
how I enjoy it!"

And so, I came to learn the Satono Crown 
way of sauna lounging!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're all hydrated, right? Well then, 
let's head in right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The heat steadily stinging my skin... The 
scent of wood clearing through my nose... 
Quite nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Sweat's pouring like a waterfall. 
It feels like I'm flushing everything 
unnecessary out...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Just ten minutes like this...! It'll warm 
up not just your hands and face, but right 
to your very core...!"

After the sauna comes the cold plunge, 
followed by relaxing in the open air. 
Cooling off on the bench, all the tension 
melted away...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaah......! So refreshed......!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I take about five minutes for 
an open-air bath... That way, I don't get 
too chilled...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah! For the upcoming campaign, this 
proposal might really draw in more 
customers...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a waterproof idea notebook. Ideas 
just keep popping up one after another 
while resting in the sauna, you know~!

True, as the heat leaves my body, I can 
feel my mind clearing up.
choice_data_list:
That's it, for the next training 
session...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did you come up with an idea too, Trainer? 
Then I'll jot it down in my notebook!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Carrot milk is the only way to go after a 
sauna! Come on, have some with me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, gulp...*!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew...♪ It's soaking right through to my 
core~~...♪

Perhaps it's thanks to following Satono 
Crown's recommended sauna routine. My body 
feels completely refreshed, put into a 
state of total bliss.
choice_data_list:
Your style of sauna time was so 
relaxing...♪

I think your style of sauna time really 
soothed me...♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I can't have you being satisfied just 
yet. My way of having fun is only getting 
started.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
First, we get sauna food at this 
cafeteria. I definitely recommend the mapo 
tofu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Eating spicy food and sweating it all out 
feels so amazing♪"

Following Satono Crown's recommendations 
after that, I fully enjoyed massages, 
bedrock baths, and more. Thanks to that, 
my body feels completely light...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: How was it? Did you like that shop?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanted to share my favorite 
things with you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is unforgiving, after 
all. There will probably be times when 
we're both battered and worn out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yet at times like that, the two of us go 
into that sauna, laugh together... and get 
back our strength to keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It made me think that I want to keep 
running with you forever like this, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because you're my precious partner.

"Precious partner." Those words warm my 
heart...
choice_data_list:
…I wanna cool off a little longer before 
heading back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me! Why don't we try the 
aroma sauna next time?

On the way back to the academy, Satono 
Crown and I chatted about how to best 
enjoy saunas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't we stop by a 
convenience store nearby? I just got a 
craving for some ice cream.

Taking a detour with Satono Crown, we 
cooled our flushed faces.
